channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Exército do Lula' sai do ar após ordem de Kassio e deve voltar após 48h
item.description: The WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', linked to Deputy André Janones, was temporarily suspended following a decision by TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques and is expected to resume operations within 48 hours.

item.title: Moro mobiliza 230 prefeitos e quase 3 mil lideranças do PR em ato de apoio a Flávio
item.description: Sergio Moro mobilized 230 mayors and nearly 3,000 PR leaders in Curitiba to support Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 election campaign, strengthening political alliances. The event aimed to consolidate key figures from PL backing the candidate.

item.title: Lula planeja ato no Planalto para celebrar fim da escala 6x1
item.description: President Lula plans an event at Planalto to celebrate the approval of the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, a key campaign priority. He is engaging with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to fast-track the legislation, which could be voted on in both rounds during the same session.

item.title: Tarcísio estreia em campanha de Flávio com viagem a Porto Alegre nesta 4ª
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas travels to Porto Alegre to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, marking their first joint event outside the state. The partnership aims to strengthen alliances for the runoff election. Tarcísio had already endorsed Flávio after his re-election, reinforcing cooperation between the two leaders.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: entenda o que acontece se o Senado aprovar a proposta nesta quarta-feira
item.description: The Brazilian Senate is expected to vote Wednesday on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing weekly hours from 44 to 40. Approval will not immediately change rules, requiring a second vote, promulgation, and a 14-month transition. Flávio Bolsonaro announced support for the PEC after initial criticisms, while Lula attributes the shift to social pressure.

item.title: Lula divulga carta a evangélicos com defesa da família e fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Lula publishes letter to evangelicals emphasizing family protection, end of 6×1 shift, and betting ban, requesting votes guided by divine discernment. The campaign launches a WhatsApp channel focused on Christian values.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1 no plenário do Senado: entenda o que diz o texto e a regra de transição
item.description: The Senate president scheduled the vote on the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule, a key electoral pledge of Lula. The bill, already approved by the CCJ and the Chamber, reduces the weekly workhours from 44 to 40 over two years and ensures two paid weekly rest days. Flávio Bolsonaro publicly supported the initiative.

item.title: Campanha de Lula lança cartas direcionadas a evangélicos e católicos
item.description: Lula and the campaign will launch letters targeting evangelicals and Catholics to promote dialogue, replicating the 2022 initiative. The strategy is part of efforts to win voters traditionally aligned with the right.

item.title: A abstenção e o poder do voto de quem não votou - O Assunto #1824
item.description: The episode examines the record 33.5 million absent voters in the first round and how they could decide the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Jairo Nicolau explains the profiles and reasons for non-voters, emphasizing the need for mobilization.

item.title: TSE julga ações sobre vídeos que ligam Lula e Flávio ao crime
item.description: The TSE judged four cases involving social media videos linking President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to criminal factions, ordering the removal of content deemed defamatory or lacking factual basis.

item.title: Votar PEC da Escala 6x1 é oportunismo
item.description: The government shows opportunism by scheduling the vote on the PEC that modifies the 6x1 work schedule for the Senate less than two weeks before the election runoff. The issue has been contaminated by electoral interests, harming a balanced debate on the proposal's economic impact in Brazil.

item.title: Canal 'Exército do Lula' sai do ar no WhatsApp após Nunes Marques estabelecer prazo de 48 horas para retomada
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel was suspended after TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques required its registration as an official campaign communication tool within 48 hours. The suspension occurred due to allegations of spreading fake news against Flávio Bolsonaro, though the rapporteur Cueva had restored the service before Nunes Marques overturned the decision. The broadcast list has 4.2 million followers and is managed by Congressman André Janones.

item.title: Pesquisa aponta que 42% da população quer acesso gratuito à cultura nos próximos anos
item.description: A survey by the Itaú Foundation found that 42% of the Brazilian population supports free cultural access as a priority. Class inequality and violence are the main obstacles to attending cultural events, with 63% of high-income classes going to the cinema compared to only 18% of lower-income classes. Insecurity and financial costs are the most cited barriers.

item.title: Primeira pesquisa Quaest do 2º turno será divulgada nesta quarta-feira (14)
item.description: Quaest will release its first poll for the 2026 presidential runoff on Wednesday (14), featuring Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT). The survey, commissioned by Globo and O Globo, interviewed 2,154 people from October 10 to 13, with a two-point margin of error. Datafolha will also publish a new poll this week, keeping the race statistically tied.

item.title: Eleições 2026: qual a diferença entre o primeiro e o segundo turno? Entenda e veja como votar
item.description: The 2026 runoff election on October 25 determines only the president and governor races in five states and the Federal District. Voters must bring ID and turn off devices, checking polling locations via the TSE website.

item.title: Aliados de Motta fazem contas para mantê-lo na presidência da Câmara e Centrão fala em ‘autopreservação’
item.description: Allies of the Chamber of Deputies president, Hugo Motta (Republicans-PB), are maneuvering to secure his reelection in 2025, relying on Centrão support and a self-preservation strategy. The PL, strengthened on the right, has already signaled interest in congressional leadership roles, but Centrão sectors believe over-concentration of power in one party would weaken the others. The race for the Chamber and Senate presidencies remains open, with key bargaining chips like amendments and committee positions already under negotiation.

item.title: Senado deve votar nesta quarta PEC que acaba com a escala 6x1
item.description: The Brazilian Senate will vote on Wednesday on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing the weekly workload from 44 to 40 hours and guaranteeing two paid rest days. The proposal, supported by both governing and opposition parties, is expected to be enacted by Thursday (22), ahead of the 2026 electoral runoff. Jair Bolsonaro’s ally Flávio Bolsonaro reversed his stance to support the measure, while Lula’s campaign considers it a priority.

item.title: Com pacote para MEI, Lula tenta se aproximar de público-alvo na eleição e se apropria de bandeira do bolsonarismo
item.description: Lula announced a $3.5 billion package for MEIs, including tax debt forgiveness and a commitment to $1,000 deposits starting in 2027, targeting strategic voters in the 2026 election against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio deve votar fim da escala 6x1 à distância enquanto faz campanha com aliados em Porto Alegre
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is expected to vote remotely in favor of the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule while campaigning in Rio Grande do Sul. This marks a strategic shift after months of criticism toward the proposal, which he previously labeled opportunistic. Aligned with allies such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Sergio Moro, he aims to expand his voter base in the region.

item.title: Senado vota fim da escala 6x1: governo tenta aprovar PEC em dois turnos e oposição resiste; entenda estratégias
item.description: The Senate votes on Wednesday on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, with the government attempting to pass it in two rounds the same day while the opposition insists on following the regular interval. The strategy aims to enact the measure before the second round of the election, with the opposition accusing the debate of being politically exploited. Flávio Bolsonaro announced support for the PEC but maintains criticism of how the voting process is being handled.

item.title: PEC da Segurança deve ser votada por comissão do Senado, mas análise no plenário é incerta
item.description: The Senate Constitution and Justice Committee is set to vote on the Security PEC, which had its merit approved in September but still awaits analysis of amendments. Despite the approval of the base text, there is no agreement to bring it to the floor yet. Senators from the base and opposition discuss changes, while Lula demands support from Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: As convicções elásticas de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro voted in favor of reducing the workday, after months aligned with pro-capital discourse. The article highlights a apparent contradiction between his traditional role as a defender of the business sector and this new stance as a defender of workers.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: Senado faz última sessão de debates e deve votar o texto hoje
item.description: The Senate will hold its final debate session and vote on the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule, replacing it with five workdays and two rest days. A special timeline will allow for enactment before the election runoff. Flávio Bolsonaro changed his stance and now supports the measure, aiding in vote gathering.

item.title: Desistência de Flávio em debates vira meme na internet: “Arregão”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced he will not attend the debate hosted by Band, sparking memes on social media, particularly on X, referencing an incident where he fainted during a debate in 2016. Supporters of Lula criticized the absence as cowardice, mocking him as 'cagão'. Flávio did not explain the reason for skipping and said his participation in the Globo debate is not yet confirmed.

item.title: Após decisão de Nunes Marques, canal 'Exército de Lula' sai do ar e poderá ser retomado após 48 horas
item.description: Following a ruling by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel was suspended but may resume operations after 48 hours, per electoral court rules. The tool, with over 4 million subscribers and coordinated by André Janones, faced legal action from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign and required formal electoral registration.

item.title: Lula critica Flávio em vídeo sobre 6 X 1 narrado por Wagner Moura
item.description: President Lula released a video narrated by Wagner Moura criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro and other lawmakers defending the 6 X 1 work schedule, advocating for a 40-hour workweek with paid days off. The constitutional amendment (PEC), already approved by the Senate's CCJ, seeks expedited approval but faces resistance from Flávio's allies in Congress. Lula accuses the PL's coordination of attempting to stall the vote through strategic absences.

item.title: Vasco se torna oitavo clube brasileiro a ganhar Boca Juniors na Bombonera em jogos oficiais
item.description: Vasco became the eighth Brazilian club to defeat Boca Juniors at La Bombonera, with a goal from Adson in the Copa Sudamericana semifinal. The victory puts the team in a strong position to reach the final.

item.title: Lula divulga carta a evangélicos com defesa da família, fim das bets e da escala 6×1
item.description: Lula releases a letter to evangelicals defending family values, the end of 'bets', and the PEC that eliminates the 6×1 work scale. He claims to have reached the presidency through divine protection and positions himself as a defender of Brazilian families with concrete actions, ahead of a tightly contested runoff against Bolsonaro's son.

item.title: Favoritismo amplia cobrança por propostas e Flávio Bolsonaro se esquiva
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL candidate in the runoff, focused on building alliances with centrist parties and avoided detailing proposals, especially on the economy, despite being seen as the favorite.

item.title: Apoio do MDB a Flávio fortalece Nunes como sucessor de Tarcísio
item.description: MDB's support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential race strengthens Ricardo Nunes as a potential successor to Tarcísio de Freitas in 2030. This alliance expands Nunes' bases for future elections. The strategy is part of a power coalition game.

item.title: Modo alerta na campanha de Lula impulsiona ofensiva digital e nas ruas
item.description: Lula and the PT entered alert mode after trailing Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round, spurring street protests, digital activism, and independent initiatives to narrow Bolsonaro's lead.

item.title: Abstenção muda e passa a ser maior entre os mais pobres, afetando Lula
item.description: Voter abstention in Brazil shifted profile in 2026, with higher non-voting rates among lower-income voters (21.3%) compared to wealthier ones (20.3%). This shift may negatively affect President Lula's support base.

item.title: Erika Hilton aciona TSE contra canal “Tropa do Flávio” no WhatsApp
item.description: Federal lawmaker Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting the suspension of the 'Tropa do Flávio' WhatsApp channel for lacking judicial electoral registration, mirroring the argument used to block the 'Exército do Lula' channel. She alleges the channel, allegedly managed by Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) in support of Flávio Bolsonaro, spreads electoral misinformation including fake images and AI-generated racist content.

item.title: Flávio defende rever grade curricular e crítica aprovação automática
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro advocates for revising the Base Nacional Comum Curricular to prepare students for future labor market changes, particularly with technology and artificial intelligence. He criticizes the automatic passing policy in schools and emphasizes the need to reform education from teacher training to municipal, state, and federal management.

item.title: Flávio, Tarcísio e Nunes convocam apoiadores para ato na Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Ricardo Nunes called supporters to a rally on Paulista Avenue on Sunday (Oct 18, 2026) at 11am, as part of the campaign for the second round of the presidential elections scheduled for October 25. The event will take place one week after Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) held a protest in the same area, which gathered thousands of demonstrators.

item.title: “El Salvador é pouco”, diz Flávio sobre plano de segurança
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, stated that El Salvador's public security model is insufficient for Brazil and promised to create over 500,000 prison vacancies, along with advocating chemical castration for those convicted of sexual crimes and harsher measures against criminals.

item.title: Em disputa por bandeiras rivais, Flávio muda discurso sobre 6x1 e Lula faz aceno a empreendedores
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro shifted his stance on the 6x1 work scale, stating he will vote in favor of the proposal, while Lula launched a package of benefits for entrepreneurs under the 'prosperity' brand. Both made strategic moves on Tuesday to appropriate traditionally opposing campaign issues in the 2026 electoral race.

item.title: Mendonça muda voto e TSE manda remover postagem de Flávio que liga Lula a crime organizado
item.description: The TSE ordered the removal of posts linking Lula to organized crime after rapporteur André Mendonça changed his vote. The publications used contextless quotes from Lula and associated him with factions like PCC and Comando Vermelho. The decision was unanimously approved by the full court.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula fazem ato sob chuva em São Paulo
item.description: Lula's supporters held the 'Ato da Virada' at Largo da Batata in São Paulo, despite the rain, to back his reelection. The rally included figures like Fernando Haddad, Simone Tebet, and Marina Silva, and featured criticism of the right and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Participants expressed concerns over the 6 X 1 work schedule and accused opponents of fearing an electoral turnaround.

item.title: Nova pesquisa testa disputa entre Flávio e Lula a uma semana do segundo turno
item.description: A new PoderData poll, registered with the TSE, measures the 2026 runoff race between Lula and Flávio one week before the October 25 vote. The latest survey showed a technical tie, with Flávio at 51% and Lula at 49%. The upcoming poll will assess voting preferences, candidate rejection rates, and evaluations of Lula's government.

item.title: Lula garante versão universitária do “Pé de Meia” caso seja reeleito
item.description: Lula announced a university version of the Pé de Meia program, offering R$ 700 monthly and R$ 2,500 at the end of each year, aimed at supporting students in a potential re-election. He participated in events supporting microentrepreneurs and campaign activities. The announcement was made via social media, with backing from political leaders across several cities nationwide.

item.title: Flávio faz visita ao pai em prisão domiciliar e recebe apoios em SP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest in Brasília, following the end of restrictions imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Later, he attended an MDB event in São Paulo, which officially provided majority support for his candidacy in the second round of elections. The meeting included party leaders and state governors.

item.title: TSE estabelece limites para campanhas de Lula e Flávio associarem adversários ao crime organizado
item.description: The TSE established boundaries for campaigns by Lula and Flávio, allowing fact-based criticisms but prohibiting direct associations with organized crime without proof. Publications exploring specific connections to investigated figures were deemed legitimate, while content linking candidates to criminal factions generically was blocked.

item.title: Lula escreve carta para evangélicos e diz que fim da escala 6x1 permite mais tempo para ir a igreja
item.description: Lula released a letter addressed to Brazilian evangelicals requesting support for his reelection and highlighting initiatives such as the end of the 6x1 shift and the ban on online betting. He also launched the WhatsApp channel 'Christians with Lula 13' and emphasized family and religious values.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que já fez o Brasil economizar R$ 220 bilhões com a dívida pública
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed his candidacy reduced future interest rates by 2 percentage points, saving Brazil R$220 billion, criticizing Lula's administration for increasing public debt from 72% to 83% of GDP. He attributes the crisis to fiscal irresponsibility and investor distrust, proposing to cut interest spending to free up budget resources.

item.title: Manifestantes realizam protestos pró-Lula em 11 capitais nesta terça-feira (13)
item.description: Supporters held pro-Lula protests in 11 Brazilian cities on Tuesday (13) ahead of the October 25 presidential runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro. The rallies aim to mobilize votes after a historic narrow 1.87-point gap in the first round. Political leaders and former ministers participated across multiple capitals.

item.title: Milhares de estudantes tomam a Esplanada em apoio a Lula
item.description: Thousands of students demonstrated support for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at the Esplanade of Ministries in Brasília, demanding the end of the 6x1 schedule, defense of social programs, free education and SUS, and opposing privatizations. During the march, young people highlighted the impact of policies such as Prouni in the lives of peripheral students, reinforcing the discourse of inclusion and defense of democracy. The mobilization also addressed issues such as women's rights, LGBT communities and protection of the poor.

item.title: TSE determina reexibição de propaganda de Flávio Bolsonaro após programa ser veiculado sem áudio
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court ordered the rebroadcast of Jair Bolsonaro's mandatory electoral advertisement after a technical failure prevented nationwide audio transmission. The new broadcast will take place on Wednesday, immediately after the afternoon free electoral slot, with costs covered by broadcasters as per electoral fairness regulations.

item.title: Ministro do TSE determina que Jorge Messias remova vídeo em apoio a Lula feito com IA
item.description: TSE Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze ordered the removal of an AI-generated video supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, requiring its withdrawal within 24 hours under risk of electoral violation. The ruling targets Attorney General Jorge Messias and Meta, emphasizing the need for clear disclosure when content is AI-produced to ensure electoral transparency. The video, depicting a child and an elderly person in a pro-Lula parade, was deemed irregular campaign material for failing to disclose its synthetic origin.

item.title: TSE derruba propagandas que associam Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro ao crime organizado de forma genérica e fixa limites
item.description: The TSE struck down ads that generically linked Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro to criminal organizations, requiring criticisms to be made within the political debate. The court highlighted excessive judicialization of campaigns, with over 217% more lawsuits compared to the previous period. The ruling aims to prevent misinformation and imbalance in the electoral process.
